title: Inspector Gadget
about: A security guard rebuilt with gadgets becomes a cyborg detective chasing an evil tycoon.
cue: Serve the snacks when Gadget finally gets the helicopter hat working.
faces: Riverton soft pretzels with cheese sauce

Scatter with ham and mozzarella.Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly.Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200°C until golden.Rest for a couple of minutes before serving.Riverton soft pretzels with cheese sauceThe city of RivertonHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft pretzel knots dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, with a hot cheddar sauce for dunking.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour.Shape 8 knots and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds.Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar.Loaded potato skins with baconGo go Gadget fork.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDetective's spaghetti with beef raguBeef, carrot and celery tomato sauce tossed with spaghetti and parmesanHow to make it500g spaghetti600g beef mince2 carrots, finely diced2 celery sticks, finely diced800g crushed tomatoes100g parmesan, grated2 tbsp olive oilBrown the mince in the oil, then add the carrot and celery and soften.Add the tomatoes and simmer, stirring now and then.Cook the spaghetti and toss through the sauce. Cover with plenty of parmesan.Claw's lair smoky chipotle chilliSanford Scolex, the Claw, in his dark lairHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck simmered slowly with kidney beans, mild chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and buttered cornbread.Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches.Soften an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin and 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, then a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml beef stock.Return the beef, cover and simmer 3 hours.Add a drained can of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.Bake a packet of cornbread mix following the directions.Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.SweetsGadgetmobile cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with grey icing and chocolate button wheelsHow to make it125g butter, soft150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml milk200g icing sugarblack food colouring, a drop12 chocolate buttonsBeat the butter and sugar, then the eggs. Fold in the flour and milk.Spoon into a lined muffin tin and bake at 175°C. Cool.Mix the icing sugar with a little water and a tiny drop of black colouring to make grey icing. Ice the cakes.Press on chocolate buttons for wheels and let the icing set.DrinksPenny's lemonadeFresh lemonade topped with soda water and sliced lemon over iceHow to make it150g caster sugar150ml hot water6 lemons, juiced, plus 1 sliced1 L cold soda water1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Mix the lemon juice and syrup in a jug and top with soda water.Pour over ice with sliced lemon.Vanilla colaThe Gadgetmobile insists on premium only.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
